priceSnapshot.note: Up +0.37% since morning's close (84,181.1 -> 84,491.9) and +0.60% on the 24h window (open24h 83,987.0). Session range since morning a tight 83,818.0-84,571.4 -- both reduceIf 82,874.5 and addIf 84,944.4 stayed clear, untested for a 7th and 3rd straight session respectively. Funding flipped from mildly positive to negative (+0.00074% -> -0.00206%, shorts now paying longs), OI held essentially flat ($2,387.7M -> $2,385.5M), L/S account ratio ticked up slightly (1.32 -> 1.33). Daily MACD histogram rolled over for the first time in three sessions (245.32 -> 256.50 -> 191.16) even as price printed a fresh session high -- an early bearish divergence worth watching.

reduceIf.confirmation: Unchanged since the Sep-24 flush -- untested for a 7th straight session. A settled 1H close below 82,874.5 would end the hold and signal the recovery has failed. Session low since morning (83,818.0) stayed clear.

addIf.confirmation: Unchanged since Sep-25 morning's failed breakout -- still capped by the 84,724 close and the 85,258.8 wick. A settled 1H close above 84,944.4 would confirm the range top is breaking. Session high since morning (84,571.4) stayed under it, within ~373 points.

decisionBox.changed: No level change: reduceIf (82,874.5) and addIf (84,944.4) both carry forward untouched. What moved since morning: funding flipped from +0.00074% to -0.00206% (shorts now paying longs), OI roughly flat ($2,387.7M -> $2,385.5M), L/S ratio ticked up slightly (1.32 -> 1.33), and 1H momentum kept building (MACD hist +36.45 -> +41.07) -- but the daily MACD histogram rolled over for the first time in three sessions (245.32 -> 256.50 -> 191.16) even as price hit a fresh session high (84,181.1 -> 84,491.9). That divergence, plus the 4H MACD histogram turning negative (-44.48) despite price sitting above all 4H EMAs, argues for staying patient rather than chasing the range top. Position stays HOLD.
